title: Taskcard Execution Contract
description: Schema for taskcard execution contracts (FF-SGOV-001 EP-008). Defines skill routes, path scope, and receipt requirements for each taskcard.

skill_ids.description: One or more registered skill IDs from .supervisor/skill-registry.yaml that authorize this taskcard's work

allowed_paths.description: File paths or glob patterns this taskcard is allowed to mutate

receipt_required.description: If true, an execution receipt must be written to .local/skill-execution-receipts/ after completion

direct_mutation_allowed.description: If false (default), all mutations must go through the skill invocation path. If true, direct file edits are permitted.

forbidden_paths.description: File paths this taskcard must NOT write to

lane_id.description: Execution lane (L01–L13) this taskcard belongs to

max_changed_files.description: Maximum number of files this taskcard may change in a single execution
